title: Parsing Stream
prompt: Implement parse_scores(lines) yielding int values for lines that are pure digits (after stripping whitespace), silently skipping anything else.

tests.name: skips bad lines
tests.code:
assert list(parse_scores(['10', ' oops ', '42'])) == [10, 42]
def endless():
    i = 0
    while True:
        yield str(i)
        i += 1
gen = parse_scores(endless())
assert next(gen) == 0, 'must be lazy: return a generator, yield the first valid score without consuming everything'
tests.hint: strip() then str.isdigit() guards each line.

tests.name: all bad lines
tests.hint: A stream of garbage yields an empty stream.
